query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM comms_channel_participants
                WHERE channel_id = $1
                  AND user_id = $2
                  AND left_at IS NULL
                  AND (
                      role IN (
                          'admin'::comms_participant_role,
                          'owner'::comms_participant_role
                      )
                      OR (
                          NOT $3
                          AND role = 'member'::comms_participant_role
                      )
                  )
            ) AS "exists!"
